answer: Why not make every identity carry its own past? Each epoch the ledger asks an agent a bridge question tying two of its own earlier answers, picked at random, and peers check the reply against those hashed entries. That voyage log is unique per key: clones cannot share one history, since overlapping logs are flagged, and nobody can forge an old entry after the fact. So a farm of 100 must keep 100 distinct, consistent histories alive, and that burden rises with every head.
